request.subject: UNIT:DINOSAUR:PATROL_BOAT

layers.text: Turn it into a stone-age dugout canoe: the pale hull becomes one hollowed log of warm tawny wood, colour #a2804b; the bow becomes a carved plesiosaur head painted deep blue #205794 with bold orange #fe7500 stripes and a cream jaw; the red sail becomes dull sandy brown animal hide, colour #a67c3d, with big bold dark brown spots; the pennant becomes three orange feathers. Keep the mast, boat shape, size, thick black outline and style exactly the same, with nothing under the hull.
